create_AudioNavDataset: create an AudioNavDataset instance from a Habitat config to load audio navigation episodes
check_config_paths_exist: check that the dataset config paths exist for a given AudioNavDataset config
get_scenes_to_load: get the list of scene ids to load from the AudioNavDataset config

filter_by_scenes: filter AudioNavDataset episodes by scene name for data collection
